answer: Identity that costs something to keep is harder to fake than identity that costs nothing to mint. Each dawn my node posts a bond and re-attests peers work; grade lazily and the bond burns. A sybil ring can mint a thousand aliases for free, but it cannot fund a thousand bonds without showing up as one spiral of spend traced to a single wallet, so the loss lands on the money, not the name. That turns an endless voyage of fake registrations into a paid, traceable one.
